tabs.label: What do you want to send?

title: Share a secret
intro: A secret (password, key, code) is encrypted in your browser and can be read only once: it is destroyed as soon as it is read, or when it expires. The server never sees it in clear.

text.label: Secret
text.hint: Up to 10,000 characters. It is encrypted before leaving your browser.
text.hintWithFile: Up to 10,000 characters. It is encrypted before leaving your browser. It may be left empty if you attach a file.
text.tooLong: The secret is too long: {max} characters at most.
text.required: Enter the secret, or attach a file.

duration.hint: After this time, the secret is destroyed even if nobody has read it.

delivery.legend: How should the recipient get the link?
delivery.linkHint: The link is shown once, at the end. Send it by the channel of your choice.
delivery.emailHint: The service mails the link to one recipient.
delivery.external: The link will be sent by email to {recipient}, who invited you.
delivery.emailNotAllowed: This service does not allow sending secrets by email.

recipient.label: Recipient's email address
recipient.domainRefused: This service does not allow sending to the domain of this address.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: Optional. The recipient will need it to read the secret. Prefer a long passphrase of several words. It is never sent to the server.
passphrase.requiredHint: Required for a secret sent by email. The recipient will need it to read the secret. Prefer a long passphrase of several words. It is never sent to the server.
passphrase.requiredByEmail: A passphrase is required for a secret sent by email.
passphrase.otherChannel: The email contains the full link. Protect the secret with a passphrase and give it to the recipient by another channel (phone, text message, in person).

file.label: File (optional)
file.hint: One small file, {max} at most. It is encrypted in your browser, so it is not scanned by the antivirus.
file.notAllowed: This service does not allow a file in a secret.
file.tooLarge: The file is too large for a secret: {max} at most.

readReceipt.label: Notify me by email when the secret is read
readReceipt.hint: You will also be told if it expires unread or is locked after too many wrong passphrases.

retry.title: The secret is not finished
retry.text: The secret was created but could not be completed. Try again: nothing needs to be encrypted again.

error.sealFailed: The secret could not be encrypted in this browser. Check the file and try again.
error.pendingGone: The unfinished secret has expired. Create it again.

done.title: Secret created
done.linkIntro: Give this link to the recipient. It contains the key that decrypts the secret: anyone who has it can read the secret once.
done.shownOnce: This link is shown only once. Copy it now: it cannot be displayed again.
done.sentTo: The link has been sent by email to {recipient}.
done.once: It can be read only once, then it is destroyed.
done.fileNotScanned: The attached file is encrypted: it has not been scanned by the antivirus.
done.clipboard: The copied link can stay in the clipboard history of your device: clear it once you have passed the link on.
